text: Have you ever uploaded a photo to ChatGPT and
wondered how does it know all of this It can
tell you what's in the image It can
read handwritten notes explain graphs solve math problems even
understand memes But here's
the strange part ChatGPT never
actually sees your photo It doesn't
have eyes It doesn't
recognize faces the way humans do In fact
the image you upload disappears almost immediately Instead it
gets transformed into something completely different So today
let's follow your photo on its journey inside
ChatGPT The moment
you click upload your image begins a transformation To us
it's a picture Maybe it's
your dog a sunset or a screenshot of
an error message But to
a computer it's nothing more than a giant
grid of tiny colored dots called pixels Zoom in far
enough and every image becomes a mosaic of little
squares Each pixel stores
just three numbers red green and blue That's it A
normal phone
photo can contain millions of pixels which means millions
of tiny color values At this point
ChatGPT doesn't know it's looking at
a dog or a car or even a
human All it sees
is a massive collection of numbers So the first
challenge is turning those numbers into something meaningful Instead
of trying
to understand the whole image at once the model
breaks it into hundreds of small squares Think of cutting
a giant puzzle into tiny pieces Each piece is
called a patch Every patch contains
just a tiny part of the image maybe part
of an eye a wheel a leaf a keyboard
key Individually these patches
don't tell the full story but together
they contain everything Each patch is
then converted into mathematical representation called an embedding Now don't let the
word scare you An embedding is simply
a way of representing information as numbers that capture
patterns instead of raw colors At this stage the original image
is already gone What remains is a collection of
mathematical descriptions Now comes the clever part ChatGPT
doesn't examine these patches one
after another It looks at all of them
together Imagine you're trying to identify a
bicycle You don't look at just one wheel
You notice another wheel the handlebars, the
pedals, the seat and your brain connects them
into one object The AI does something similar It compares
every patch with every other
patch It asks questions like which parts belong
together what seems important what objects are interacting
This process is called attention Attention allows
the model to understand relationships
not just objects That's why it knows the difference between
a dog chasing a person and a person
chasing a dog The same two objects but a completely
different story It isn't memorizing images it's understanding patterns
and relationships By now ChatGPT has
built an internal
mathematical understanding of the image But you
didn't upload a photo just
to have it analyzed You asked a question. Maybe what's wrong
with this code or can you explain this
graph or translate this sign Now something fascinating happens
The image information
is combined with your
question To the language model both become part
of the same conversation The model doesn't have a
hidden database
of captions waiting to be matched Instead it
generates a brand-new response one
word at a time just like it does when
you're chatting normally The only difference is its understanding
comes from both
text and vision this time Understanding images is one
thing creating them is another
When you ask ChatGPT to generate an image it
doesn't open a library of existing pictures
It starts with something that looks completely random. Just
static. pure visual noise then step by step it
removes that noise while following your prompt If you
ask for a futuristic city at sunset in
a watercolor style the model gradually reshapes the random
pixel First, rough colors appear. Then buildings. then
lighting then tiny details
Each step gets slightly closer to your description
until eventually what
started as meaningless noise becomes a completely new image
It's less like drawing with a paintbrush and more
like sculpting order
out of chaos So the next time
you upload a photo to ChatGPT remember it
never actually sees what you see It transforms millions
of colored pixels into mathematical patterns connects those patterns
together combines them with language and finally generates an
answer one word at a time And somehow all
of that happens in just a few seconds The
more I learn about how these systems work the more fascinating
they become Because behind one simple upload button is
decades of computer science machine
learning and engineering working together If you enjoyed this
deep dive and want to understand how AI
really works, not just what it can do consider
subscribing In the next video we'll go even deeper
and explore how ChatGPT
generates images from nothing but a sentence Thank
you for watching this video see you
in the next one
the next one peace
